title: Write an issue someone can reproduce
summary: A GitHub issue can record a bug or proposed task. A useful bug report gives steps, expected behaviour and actual behaviour.
introduction: A GitHub issue can record a bug or proposed task. A useful bug report gives steps, expected behaviour and actual behaviour. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain write an issue someone can reproduce
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A GitHub issue can record a bug or proposed task. A useful bug report gives steps, expected behaviour and actual behaviour.

blocks.code:
Title: Search misses lowercase moon
Steps: type moon in the book search
Expected: Moon appears
Actual: no matching book appears
blocks.title: Write an issue someone can reproduce

blocks.text: A maintainer can repeat the exact steps. The issue describes a problem; it does not itself change the search code.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a browser detail if it affects the bug.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Never put passwords or private learner records into a public issue.
For more detail later, use this [GitHub further reading](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started).

seo.title: GitHub: Write an issue someone can reproduce
seo.description: Learn about write an issue someone can reproduce in GitHub. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
